lines.en: label day269:
scene norikointro1
Wednesday begins with somewhat of a change of fate.
Or, as a certain normal [teenage]girl would likely say instead, the result of an unfortunate twist in an otherwise unbending cycle.
Or something along the lines.
I actually took it upon myself to inform Maya of Kirin’s transfer plan the other day and, just as expected, something like this has never happened before.
Instead of getting philosophical, however, she just sighed to herself and ran her fingers through her hair, saying something I can’t quite remember as she walked off.
I imagine she just called me disgusting. She does that often.
Sure, the context of the rest of the conversation didn’t really invoke any need for me to be insulted, but that’s never stopped her before.
Why stop now? When things are finally becoming new and exciting?
Or terrible.
I guess we’ll just have to wait and see.
: Soooo...hey!
: I’m Kirin Kanda, and I’ve met pretty much all of you already since I totally crashed your Christmas party.
: But I guess I’m here to crash your class now as well.
: I’m not expecting any sort of warm welcome or anything like that, but-
scene norikointro2
: HECK YES! KIRIN KANDA AND MIKU MARUYAMA IN THE SAME CLASS!
: EVERYBODY GIVE HER A ROUND OF APPLAUSE!
: Uhh...no. Please don’t do that.
scene norikointro3
: What I was trying to say before Miku jumped in...is that I hope we can all get along and...you know, be normal students together or whatever.
scene norikointro4
: Sooooo...yeah. I guess if anyone has any questions or anything like that, I’d be more than happy to answer.
if ayanelust10 == False:
: If not, I’ll just take my seat and we can all pretend that I’ve been here the entire time and didn’t just randomly show up one day.
The class remains silent for a moment apart from Miku’s cheering and several other girls who she’s able to coax into awkwardly clapping for Kirin.
Kirin doesn’t react, of course.
She doesn’t look to me for approval, either.
In fact, she basically doesn’t even acknowledge my existence as soon as she gets the ball rolling.
It’s possible that she’s just trying to avoid raising suspicion, but-
Isn’t that the opposite of what she’d normally do?
Is a normal introduction in a room full of people she knows truly fun to her?
else:
scene norikointro5
: I’ve got a question.
: Oh! Ayane, my best friend in the whole wide world.
: Whatever can I do for you?
: How are you and Ayane best friends?! She didn’t even clap!
: Did ya not hear my applause?!
: What are you doing?
: What do you mean? I just so happened to be transferred into this class.
: Total coincidence. Kinda crazy, huh?
: Didn’t you transfer classes less than a month ago? What was wrong with your last one?
: I felt my education was lacking in my previous environment and am now looking to improve myself.
: You have very much come to the wrong class, if that’s the case.
: I wouldn’t mind giving you a list of teachers who, you know, teach if you have a minute after[school].
scene norikointro1
: That won’t be necessary. After giving it some thought, I’ve decided that this is the right class for me.
: And if anyone has a problem with that, Ayane, they can take it up with Sensei personally.
: He approved the transfer, so if anyone is to blame here, it’s him.
scene norikointro6
: What?...
: Sensei...
: You could have at least given me a warning, or...
: To be completely honest, she just kind of sprung it on me out of nowhere.
: You did approve it, though.
: Yes. I did approve it.
: Is something wrong, Ayane? I thought you and Kirin were kind of close?
scene norikointro7
: Yeah...
: Me too...
scene norikointro8
: Welp, I suppose this concludes my introduction!
: I’d like to thank everyone for accepting me to the class and give a special thanks to Miku for making several people awkwardly clap for me.
: I totally didn’t hate that at all.
scene black
Kirin grabs her bag off of the ground and makes her way over to an unoccupied desk on the left hand side of the room.
She sits next to Io.
And, as expected of someone as outgoing as her, she immediately tries to strike up a conversation.
Unfortunately for Kirin, she picked one of the absolute worst people to talk to.
Nothing against Io, of course. It’s just...
Well-
scene norikointro9
: Hey. Are you new here as well? I don’t remember seeing you at the Christmas party.
: My old[school] exploded.
: Ooooh, a transfer then? How are you liking this place compared to the last one?
: It’s...a[school], I guess.
: I’m sorry, are you trying to become friends or something? Because I’m not really interested.
scene norikointro10
: Uhh...excuse me?
: Io! You know darn well that’s not how you’re supposed to talk to people you’re meeting for the first time!
: So, what? You want me to lie to her and tell her I want to paint our nails and go shopping for flowers or something?
: Yes! Kind of!
: I want you to actually want to do that!
: Ya can’t just rely on me forever, ya know?
scene norikointro11
: Please do excuse my rude behavior, Kanda-san.
: I would absolutely adore the prospect of painting each other’s nails and perusing the local florist for hydrangeas if you’d be so inclined.
: I kind of like you for some reason.
: Please don’t. I am not worth it.
: Please help.
: I can’t do it anymore.
scene norikointro12
: Wakana? What’s up?
: Please use my last name in front of the students, you pathetic waste of carbon.
: Wakana Watabe, what’s up?
scene norikointro13
: “What’s up” is that I’m going to throw myself off of the roof of this building if you do not get this suspiciously smart but infinitely obnoxious girl out of my classroom immediately.
: I will literally pay you. I do not care.
: I just can’t take it anymore.
: Are you going to say your catch phrase?
scene norikointro14
: I...want...to...fucking...die...
scene norikointro15
: Wakana! You can’t just walk away in the middle of a discussion!
Why does this student know Ms. Watabe’s first name?
Why does that make me jealous?
Wait, what’s even going on right now?
: You are our teacher. If you are not here to teach, then why bother-
scene norikointro16
: Getting a...
: Job in...
: Education...
scene norikointro17
: Oh my god...
: Oh my god...
: Oh my god...you’re here...
: You...
: You...
: When?
: How long?
: Why?
: If I knew this is where you went...I...I...
: I think you might have me confused with someone else.
scene norikointro18
: Absolutely not! No! I’ve...
: I've looked...everywhere for you!
: Well, clearly not everywhere because you’re here and...and I’m here and...and...
scene norikointro19
: And...
: I missed you so much...
: So...fucking...much...
: Ever since you left, I’ve been looking online and asking my sister and...
scene norikointro20
: You are extremely hard to find! You know that?!
: Like, who doesn’t have social media nowadays?! I figured even you would have caved by now, but-
scene norikointro21
: But I guess it would make sense if you wanted to avoid us...
: I mean, of course you wanted to get away from...everything that happened...
: But I always thought that I was special.
: Because you...you were special. To me.
: The most special thing in the world.
scene norikointro22
: Holy shit.
: Can I hug you?
: I’m gonna hug you.
: And I’m probably gonna cry a lot.
: But you have...no idea how much I’ve been looking forward to this...
: This is actually quite touching.
: What is? I have no idea what's even going on.
: What’s going on is I’m going to squeeze the life out of you.
: I deserve it after being as patient as I’ve been all these years.
scene norikointro23
The mysterious, pink-haired girl lunges forward and buries her face in my chest.
Within a matter of seconds, I can feel her tears seep through the fabric of my dress shirt.
She goes through short bursts every several seconds where she sobs uncontrollably.
Her fingers dig into my body with so much force that it feels doubtful she’ll ever even contemplate letting go.
This has to be someone Sensei knew before I took over and started ruining all of his relationships.
Or fixing them, depending on your ethical standpoint concerning power dynamics and how to use them to manipulate [teenage]girls.
If I had to take a guess, most people would probably consider that ruining them.
If I was the person I’m supposed to be- or if he was the person he was supposed to be instead of some memory floating out there in the ether-
This would be a touching reunion.
Probably.
I don’t know the details of his relationship with this girl, but-
: When was the last time we saw each other?
: Almost three years ago.
: It was on a Thursday.
: But you disappeared once before that, too.
: I should have probably just moved on, but...
: But I always knew I’d find you again if...
: If I didn't give up...
Huh.
There’s no easy way out of this situation, but...
I guess I could play the amnesia card?
That's been my ace in the hole so far, at least.
Ami already assumes something weird happened to my memory, but it hasn’t personally impacted her all that much, so I guess she just shrugs it off for the most part.
I mean, just telling whoever this is that I don’t remember her is sure to break her.
If she’s not already broken, that is.
But I guess we’re all a little broken at the end of the day.
Some more than others.
Some much, much more than others.
: There’s something you should probably know.
scene norikointro24
: There are a lot of things I should probably know. We’ve been out of touch for quite some time now.
: I really...really can’t believe this is happening.
: Neither can I, but...
: ...But what?
: But that’s probably because...something happened to my memory.
scene norikointro25
: What, like...amnesia?
: I hope that’s not just a convenient excuse to tell me you forgot about me.
: To me it’s more like...I never knew you in the first place.
: You’re saying all of your memories of me are just totally gone?
: Right...
: And I know it might hurt you to hear that since you’ve been searching for so long but-
scene norikointro26
: Not at all...
: Nothing hurts anymore.
: If your memories are gone, I’ll just figure out a way to get them back.
: We’ll start fresh.
: I am kinda sad, though. I was hoping you’d comment on how tall I’ve gotten.
: I finally had my growth spurt and I think I’ve gotten pretty damn cute, to tell you the truth.
: It’s kind of hard to judge that with you so close, but...yeah. I'd say you’re cute.
: If we’re starting fresh, would you mind telling me your name?
: You don’t even remember that much?
: I’m sorry.
: You don’t ever have to apologize to me. I’ll be with you forever...
: So long as you don’t run away again, of course.
: My name is Noriko Nakayama and I have been in love with you since I was six years old.
: Okay, this is suddenly much less touching.
: Nakayama?...
: ...No. There's no way.
: Uhh...that’s...
: Obviously too young, I know that. But it doesn’t change how I’ve felt all of these years.
: And how I still feel now.
: Want to run away and get married?
: Please at least finish the[school] day.
: Noriko, I-
scene norikointro27
: Ami? Are you raising your hand right now?
: Who is that?
: Oh my god, like, [niece] Ami?!
: She’s so cute now!
: Sensei, who is that?
: Uhh...I still don’t really understand myself, but-
scene norikointro28
: Maya?...
scene norikointro29
: Why.
: Why?
: Why. Why. Why?
scene norikointro30
: WHY ARE YOU HERE?!
scene norikointro31
: It’s...because of that stupid fucking[school].
: Isn't it?
: That stupid...FUCKING[school] that decided to SINK and turn everything on its GOD DAMN...FUCKING HEAD!!!
Something is wrong.
scene norikointro32
: Get out.
: Now.
: No. I’m not-
: I wasn’t asking you. I was telling you.
: Get...the fuck...out of my classroom...you filthy...stalker...bitch...
: I don’t know if I’m turned on or terrified right now.
: Rin! Shh...
: Maya...calm down for a second and-
: Get out.
: Get out get out get out.
: Get. The fuck. Out.
: Fine. Then I’ll get out.
scene black
Maya leaves her desk and slowly brings herself to the front of the classroom, stopping in front of the door and staring directly at Noriko.
scene norikointro33
: Maya, is everything-
: Stay out of this, Sensei.
: Are you planning on letting go of him any time soon?
: Not a fucking chance.
: Never again.
: I see.
: You did get taller, by the way.
: But that isn’t going to change anything.
: You were unwanted then, and you are unwanted now.
: No one will ever...in this timeline or others...ever love you.
Timeline?...Then-
: We’ll see about-
: Burn in hell, you fucking cunt.
scene norikointro34
: Well, shit.
scene norikointro35
: I see that her opinion of me hasn’t changed much.
: I’ve never seen her act that way before.
: Really?
: Guess I’m just lucky, then.
: What in the world did you do to her?
: I honestly don’t even remember, but...I don’t think I did anything?
scene norikointro36
: It doesn’t matter, though.
: We’re finally back together.
: Even if you don’t really remember me.
scene norikointro37
: Oh! By the way, hi!
: I’m Noriko and I’m pretty sure I just got kicked out of my last class, so I’ll be in here with you guys from now on.
: My interests include dismantling the patriarchy and eating so much ice cream in one sitting that I puke my brains out.
: And if you ever hear screams or weird voices or just...really loud noise in general coming from my room, that’s just my music.
: I promise I am not a serial killer and I’ve only been arrested like two times.
: What the fuck, I like her too.
: Green haired girl, hang out with me and the pink one sometime.
: Oh, dear. That sounds absolutely lovely but I’m afraid I must decline.
scene black
Noriko takes a seat in the back of the class after a few minutes and Wakana informs me that she’s filing for an “emergency transfer” effective immediately.
It seems that I’ll be taking care of Noriko from now on as well.
And as excited as I am to have yet another girl so willing to fawn all over me-
I can’t stop thinking about Maya’s outburst and all of the negative connotations and implications it carries with it.
Ami tried to go home as well after that, but I convinced her to stay and reassured her that I really have no idea what Noriko was talking about.
She seemed a lot more nervous than I’ve ever seen her before.
Ayane, on the other hand, remained calm and composed, restoring order to the room in any way she could think of.
No one bothered saying a word to Noriko other than Kirin.
Proclaiming your love for me in front of everyone is probably not the best way to introduce yourself to this classroom.
I’m sure she’ll pay the price for that in the future.
When[school] ends, I search for Maya.
I do not find her.
The day ends.

$ noriko_love += 50
Surprise! Noriko’s affection for you is already [noriko_love]!
